scope: New dashboard structural metadata only; not historical recovery or target extraction
owner_direction: Proceed with your recommendations following PR167 recommendation for a separately scoped dashboard capture
timeout_scope: Per socket operation; not a DNS or whole-run deadline
byte_budget_note: At most 10000000 accepted body bytes plus one oversize-detection byte; headers and TLS framing are not included
stopping_rules: Any binding, peer, transport, HTTP, size, schema, identity, prohibited-data or custody failure terminates the lineage
No retries, redirects, alternate endpoints, credential use, POST, target extraction, failed-output reuse or validator relaxation
Existing vault or receipt prevents execution; preexisting pending checkpoint prevents any request
next_stage: Structural success alone cannot authorize a query; source-derived exact query contract and separate scope authority remain required
public_boundary: Hashes and receipt metadata only; source remains restricted local quarantine
